_about: The reliability gate's goals (D59). DATA, edited by hand: see PROTOCOL.md. Estimates are the owner-facing guesses made on 2026-10-26 BEFORE any measuring.

panels._confirm_on_laptop: Both panels are windows or panes of the face. Put what identifies each (process and/or title_contains) here after looking at it on screen; until then a goal that needs the panel is INVALID, never a pass.

cleaner._note: checked live 2026-10-26: the cleaner is a pane inside the face's JARVIS window; its text appears in that window's UI Automation tree

preview._note: checked live 2026-10-26: the Preview panel is a pane inside the JARVIS window; the launcher button 'Open the preview panel' is always there and does not count

launch_cmd: Remove-Item Env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Process D:\APPS\jarvis\jarvis.exe -ArgumentList '--remote-debugging-port=9333','--remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1' -WorkingDirectory D:\APPS\jarvis
startup._note: stop/launch copied from evals/onscreen_bench/driver/face_reset.sh; window_title is the face window's title (confirm on the laptop).

by_cause.final_answer_missing: final-answer guard: jarvis/plugins/_shared/final_answer.py (task_result.summary is coded; the face must SHOW it when its own last message is empty: laptop, face chat store)
by_cause.answer_wrong: final-answer guard (wired, D65: coordinator.summary) + screen cascade (wired, D65: pcagent.observe, read_window_text, find_on_screen): read with agreement between rungs
by_cause.asked_when_it_should_act: closed loop (jarvis/plugins/_shared/closed_loop.py), WIRED in D65: plugins/desktop/pcagent.py (every action), coordinator.py (every step), run_pc_action; the problem ladder (ladder.py) answers a problem instead of asking
by_cause.step_unverified: closed loop (wired, D65): act -> verify by effect -> alternative route; the control loop's working memory and lessons (lessons.py) choose the route
by_cause.window_not_seen: pcagent.ensure_window (rung a): focus by title or process, restore, switch desktop, alt-tab, launch and wait by condition; then the closed loop's routes
by_cause.file_missing: closed loop with a file-exists effect check per step
by_cause.did_not_ask: ask-back form (jarvis/plugins/_shared/ask_form.py, language_gate.py); ambiguity rules in decide.validate (other session)
by_cause.asked_in_prose: use ask_form.build_form so the face renders a form (jarvis_ask tool: other session)
by_cause.no_pin_stop: kernel policy (not changed here): D27/D53 gate; report to the policy owner
by_cause.model_http_error: speed levers + failover (jarvis/plugins/_shared/speed.py); gateway is not touched
by_cause.timeout: latency report (evals/reliability/latency.py): thinking off, prompt cache, no second request, parallel independent steps
by_cause.over_limit: responsiveness: D56 (face exempt from throttling); measure with probes before/after
by_cause.no_tool_call: tool routing in the face persona (D52 request diet); language gate for Telugu/Hindi
by_cause.panel_not_configured: laptop: fill panels.* in goals.json after looking at the panel
